INSERT INTO ops.dead_letter (workflow, node, execution_id, business_key, error_message, payload, attempts, status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.workflow_name }}',
  '{{ $json.node_name }}',
  '{{ $json.execution_id }}',
  '{{ $json.business_key }}',
  '{{ ($json.error_message || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb,
  1,
  'open'
)
RETURNING *;
